newsitem.title: USA: Maine's unemployment rate falls to seven-year low.
newsitem.headline: Maine's unemployment rate falls to seven-year low.

text.p: Maine's unemployment rate fell to the lowest level in seven years, hitting 4.2 percent in November, the state Labor Department said, adding employment hit the highest level of the year at 638,500.
The drop in November, which was down from five percent in October, also marks a recovery from the year-ago rate, which stood at 5.4 percent, the department said on Wednesday.
Nonfarm wage and salary jobs rose by 1,000, with most industry sectors achieving small gains.

The rates for Maine counties ranged from 2.3 percent in Cumberland to 7.8 percent in Aroostook, when the data were not seasonally adjusted. The largest declines were seen in lodging and recreational services, as the tourist season wound down. These losses were partly offset by a 1,500-increase in hirings by local governments hiring temporary election workers.
